prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 9 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1324; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was sideswiped while changing lanes. The patient reported immediate onset of low back pain with stiffness and muscle spasm, consistent with a lumbar strain. Neurological screening at initial evaluation was unremarkable, with no radicular symptoms, motor deficits, or sensory changes noted.

Over the course of nine office visits, the patient was treated with a combination of manual therapy, guided therapeutic exercise, and a home stretching program. Pain was managed with short-term over-the-counter analgesics and the patient was advised on activity modification, including avoidance of heavy lifting and prolonged sitting during the acute phase.

Progress was steady. Range of motion improved, paraspinal muscle tenderness decreased, and the patient returned to full work duties with no restrictions by the final visit. At discharge, the patient reported pain at a minimal level with occasional discomfort after prolonged activity. The patient was instructed to continue the home exercise program and to return if symptoms worsened or new neurological symptoms developed.

Diagnosis: Acute lumbar strain, resolved or near resolution at discharge.
